title: Don't Let Claude Code Do This First
description:
Never Let Claude Code Do This First
Most people open Claude Code and immediately ask it to build a feature.
That's how you get broken code.

Before it edits a single file, make it understand your project:

1. Open your real project directory
2. Let it inspect the repo — change nothing
3. Define the outcome: users, behaviour, limits, success criteria
4. Request a plan and review which files it wants to touch
5. Let it build, then require formatter, build and tests
6. Review the diff yourself before committing

The winning workflow isn't Prompt → Generate → Deploy.
It's Explore → Plan → Build → Test → Review.

Use Claude Code like an engineering agent, not a chatbot.

Like and subscribe for more videos.

#ClaudeCode #AICoding #Anthropic #AIAgents #DeveloperTools #Programming #VibeCoding
